name: TechnicianClockingEfficiencyBoard
tagline: Live technician clocking, efficiency and labour approval for dealer workshops.
description: A complete Power Apps code component for automotive service departments: clock technicians on and off repair-order lines and idle time, see sold vs clocked vs attended hours, efficiency, productivity and overall performance, idle reasons, unclocked gaps, double clockings and overruns, rank technicians on a leaderboard and approve or query clockings before payroll.
features: Clock on / switch job / start idle / pause / clock off / resume
Efficiency, productivity and overall performance with configurable labels and targets
Attended hours from technician setup with pro-rata today and absences
Idle time by reason and unclocked gaps
Double clocking, overrun, long idle and not-clocked-off flags
Supervisor approval and query workflow with bulk actions and undo
Sold hours by pay type (customer, warranty, internal)
Phone, tablet and desktop layouts; keyboard and screen-reader support
controlType: standard (2 controls: data-set + Power Pages field)
